readme:
🏙️ Courier City — 3D Open World Transit Simulator

✨ Created & Maintained by Shubhransh Gupta ✨

A cel-shaded 3D browser game rendering seven iconic Indian cities as miniature spherical diorama worlds.
Walk on foot, drive an Auto Rickshaw, Roadster, Bullet 350, or Volvo City Bus — explore living streets, equatorial railways, and authentic regional culture directly in your browser.

--- ## 🎮 What is Courier City? **Courier City** is an interactive, browser-native 3D open-world transit simulation celebrating the pulse, architecture, and streets of India. Built entirely with WebGL and Three.js with zero heavy downloads, each city is rendered as a warm, cel-shaded cylindrical world wrapped on an equatorial transit axis. Select any city from the interactive **Survey of India** national boundary map, zoom in, and step down onto the pavement alongside thousands of animated pedestrians, bustling street vendors, local buses, and trains. --- ## ✨ Key Features ### 🇮🇳 1. Interactive Survey of India Map - Handcrafted vector map adhering strictly to official Survey of India cartographic boundaries. - Live pulsating green status pins for all active cities with instant fly-in planetary reveal transitions. - Fully responsive on desktop and mobile browsers. ### 🏙️ 2. Seven Rich Indian Diorama Cities | City | Regional Transit Line | Signature Landscapes & Landmarks | |------|------------------------|----------------------------------| | 🌊 **Mumbai** | Western Railway Suburban Line | Churchgate, Marine Drive, Chawls, Grand Road, Dadar, Arabian Sea | | 🌳 **Bengaluru** | Namma Metro Purple Line | Vidhana Soudha, Cubbon Park, MG Road, Indiranagar, BMTC Volvo Buses | | 🏛️ **Delhi** | Yellow Line Metro | Old Delhi, Chandni Chowk, Red Fort, Delhi Junction, Jama Masjid | | 🚋 **Kolkata** | Heritage Calcutta Tramway | Howrah Bridge, BBD Bag, Park Street, Victoria Memorial, Hooghly River | | 🏖️ **Chennai** | MRTS Elevated Coastal Railway | Marina Beach, Chepauk, Thirumylai, Chintadripet, Bay of Bengal | | 🕌 **Hyderabad** | MMTS Transit & Lake Ring | Charminar, Hussain Sagar Lake, Khairatabad, Buddha Statue | | 🛕 **Ahmedabad** | Sabarmati Riverfront Transit | Sabarmati Riverfront, Kalupur Heritage Station, Historic Pols | ### 🛺 3. Vehicle Driving System Press F (or tap the on-screen HUD vehicle dock) to mount and drive: - 🚶 **Foot**: Walk, sprint with Shift, and roam alleyways. - 🛺 **Namma Auto**: Agile 3-wheeler auto rickshaw with authentic auto horn. - 🏎️ **Bruno Roadster**: High-speed road cruiser for fast transit along major avenues. - 🏍️ **Bullet 350**: Iconic Royal Enfield style thumper motorcycle. - 🚌 **Volvo City Bus**: Heavy BMTC/BEST low-floor city transit bus with pneumatic bus horn. ### 🩸 4. Pedestrian Collision & Stylized Blood VFX - **Oriented Bounding Box Collision**: Vehicles feature dynamic forward-reach bumper colliders (up to 5.6m reach on the Volvo Bus). - **Stylized Blood Bursts**: Striking a pedestrian triggers an explosive 24-droplet cel-shaded crimson particle arc with gravity physics. - **Ground Splatter Decals**: Ground blood splats stain the road for ~5.5 seconds before fading smoothly. - **Stagger & Clothing Flash**: Struck NPCs receive physical knockback impulses and their clothes flash crimson for visual impact confirmation. - **Traffic Collision Mechanics**: Stepping in front of an ambient traffic bus or car triggers traffic impact alerts, blood effects, and player knockback. ### 🌅 5. Atmosphere, Time of Day & Weather - **Dynamic Lighting (T)**: Cycle between bright afternoon sunlight, warm golden hour dusk, and deep starry night with glowing windows. - **Monsoon Rain (K)**: Toggle realistic vertical rainfall with wet road reflections and audio downpours. - **Ambient City Life**: Regional street vendor signs in authentic local scripts (Devanagari, Kannada, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati) with procedural dialogue translation popups. --- ## 🕹️ Controls Guide | Key | Action | |-----|--------| | W A S D / ↑ ← ↓ → | Walk / Drive Vehicle | | Shift | Sprint on foot / Nitro boost in vehicle | | F | Cycle Vehicle (Walk ➔ Auto ➔ Roadster ➔ Bullet ➔ Bus) or board nearby bus | | H | Sound Vehicle Horn / Bicycle Bell | | E | Interact / Board Train / Talk to locals | | L | Wander mode (Automated cinematic camera) | | T | Cycle Ti
